statements.t: “We delivered a record third quarter, with sales above the high end of our outlook and adjusted earnings exceeding expectations.
Third quarter sales and adjusted diluted EPS exceeded the high end of our guidance range partially due to timing of customer orders driven by announced price increases.
We continue to expect growth in the fourth quarter to moderate from the third quarter pace.
Even so, our year-to-date performance and recent acquisition support raising our full year sales outlook implying the highest annual sales in Helios’ history.
We expect the benefits of our recent pricing actions to show more fully in 2027, and we expect to realize the cost synergies from our Radio Sound acquisition starting in early 2027.
We remain disciplined as we navigate a dynamic macro environment, finish 2026, and continue advancing toward The CORE Strategy’s 2030 targets."
The webcast replay will be available in the investor relations section of the Company’s website at www.heliostechnologies.com .
They include statements regarding current expectations, estimates, forecasts, projections, our beliefs, and assumptions made by Helios Technologies, Inc.
